task_binding.selection: Use one distal finger pad as a blunt pressing tool. Keep the measured open gripper aperture fixed; orient the other finger away from the button row. There is no grasp, closure, capture, or object lift.

initial_pixel_seeds.format: ROIs are [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]; coordinates are approximate pixels. Re-segment after every action.

right_blue.note: Partial rim; insufficient for independent circle fitting.

processing.camera_geometry: Use the supplied camera-to-environment matrices with camera rays proportional to [(u-cx)/fx, -(v-cy)/fy, -1]. Validate by positive forward range and reprojection. Recover fixed wrist-to-tool transforms from initial calibration and robot poses; update wrist cameras using current robot state.
processing.rgb: Segment red/orange and blue in HSV, fit robust cap ellipses, and track their rims separately from stationary bases and tabletop texture. Read rectified card crops; bind cards to the nearest button immediately below them. Preserve identities through geometric association.
processing.metric_geometry: Match tabletop texture across calibrated views using descriptor matching, epipolar filtering, triangulation and planar RANSAC. Fit horizontal cap circles using visible rim correspondences or temporal triangulation from calibrated wrist motion. Never obtain cap height by intersecting its center ray with the table.
processing.tool: Project public X5 finger geometry from current joints. Compute the chosen pad footprint and lowest point, plus the swept volume of both fingers. Mask tool pixels when fitting caps.
processing.uncertainty: Propagate at least two-pixel localization uncertainty, reprojection residuals and robot/calibration uncertainty into horizontal sigma_xy and vertical sigma_z. Reject poorly conditioned triangulation. All tolerances are at least three propagated standard deviations.

geometry_and_residuals.definitions: n is upward table normal; c and z0 are unpressed cap center and height; R is cap radius; p is the chosen pad's lowest surface point; r is its footprint circumradius; h=z0-z_table.
geometry_and_residuals.horizontal: e_xy = tangent-plane(p-c), expressed in world XYZ; margin M=R-r-3*sigma_xy. Require M>0 and norm(e_xy)<=M.
geometry_and_residuals.orientation: e_rot is the world-axis rotation vector aligning the pad pressing direction with -n. Require projected footprint containment and collision clearance; angular tolerance comes from those margins.
geometry_and_residuals.clearance: g=n dot p-z0. Approach clearance G=max(3*sigma_z,0.25*R).
geometry_and_residuals.press_depth: D=min(0.5*h,h-6*sigma_z). Require D>3*sigma_z and the entire tool above the table uncertainty envelope. Press residual is e_press=g+D.
geometry_and_residuals.return: e_return=z_cap-z0, measured relative to stationary base/table features.

execution.actor_interface: Send English structured text containing phase, target identity, completed/required counts, uncertainty and only the current phase fields below. The actor selects categorical world translation/rotation signs, fixed gripper state and phase transition; the executor bounds every short action.

phases.name: clear_and_orient
phases.pass: Tool orientation permits contained pad contact and keeps every other tool surface clear throughout the planned press sweep.

phases.name: press
phases.pass: Containment persists and abs(e_press)<=3*sigma_z. Latch one press candidate. Record visible cap depression if it exceeds its uncertainty; otherwise label the candidate a geometric actuation proxy.

phases.name: release_and_retreat
phases.pass: Physically retreat until g>=G and projected geometry confirms separation. A resolvable cap must return within its uncertainty. Increment exactly once for the latched candidate, then clear the latch.

execution.progression: Immediately advance on each pass. Repeat approach, press and release until the current red count is reached; then select the next target. Enable blue only after counts equal 1 and 9. Finish after blue's release-and-retreat passes.

limits_and_recovery.assumptions: Table and button bases are rigid; caps translate approximately normal to the table and spring back; centered pad depression actuates a functioning button. No exact activation stroke is known.
limits_and_recovery.unsupported: RGB and tool motion cannot prove electrical activation, contact force, hidden joint travel or native success. Report separately visible cycles and geometric proxy cycles.
limits_and_recovery.recovery: Once per episode, missing geometry permits one bounded lateral wrist viewpoint change while maintaining certified table/button clearance, followed by reconstruction. If geometry remains inadequate, halt. Ambiguous completed presses halt without automatic repetition to avoid overcounting.

provenance.status: Current initial RGB based proposal; not an executed or successful controller
